title: Shipment event (Kafka topic shipment.events, key tenant_id:shipment_id)
description: One carrier/terminal milestone for a container on a booking. Producer: the simulator (any feed in production). Consumers: ClickHouse (Kafka engine -> shipment_events). Times are ISO-8601 UTC; in the simulator they run on sim time (1 sim-day = 1 real minute).

event_id.description: Unique per event; replays keep it, so consumers dedupe on it.

port_role.description: Where on the route the location sits: loading, transhipment or discharge port.

booked_vessel.description: Vessel on the booking when the event was sent; a change is a rollover.

eta.description: Carrier ETA at the port of discharge as of this event.
